new.n: Horrigan family's Clayton farm (alternate spot for the 1930 buried gold)
new.pl: Family farm (about 880 acres) in secs 26/27/35/36 T10N R4W, Town of Clayton, Crawford County, about 7 mi SSW of Soldiers Grove (c.1915 Hixson plat, engraved "Horgen")
new.v: Money hidden around the farm (amount unknown)
new.st: The family's larger farm in Town of Clayton, about 7 mi SSW of Soldiers Grove; a 1940 account says the siblings lived on a large farm in Clayton and buried their gold. Which farm the 1930 robbers raided is not yet settled; see the main Horrigan pin. Private: permission.
new.t: The farmstead is the building by the road junction in sec. 35 on the c.1915 plat; other building sites in SW sec. 35 and in sec. 36 are the alternatives. Check LiDAR for old dig holes around them. Private: permission.
src: Hixson, Plat Book of Crawford County, Wisconsin (c.1915), Clayton plate
pinev: Farm-level: the c.1915 Hixson plat shows the family's ~880 acres across secs 26/27/35/36 T10N R4W (Town of Clayton); pin at the centre of the holding (about 900 m).
new.tovw: Lead grade C (treasure thread): alternate farm

set.t: Check LiDAR for old dig holes around the farmstead site in the north tier of sec. 2. Alternate: the family's Clayton farm, about 12 km SW (separate pin). Permission: private farm, ask first.
